previous_comment: EMA labels delivered Riltrava strengths as 160/5/7.2; RxNorm encodes the matching 120-actuation metered inhaler as 160/4.8/9 with glycopyrrolate base.
resolution: Resolved: corrected glycopyrrolate basis to bromide; 7.2 micrograms glycopyrronium base = 9 micrograms glycopyrronium bromide. Existing concept and EXACT type retained.
